mo_ta_cong_viec:
Key Responsibilities
Own the product or product line and define a clear product vision aligned with business objectives.
Develop and maintain product strategies and roadmaps.
Drive product evolution through data analysis, user feedback, and continuous improvement.
Define, monitor, and validate product KPIs to measure success.
Facilitate discovery workshops (Service Design, Product Design, Persona definition, MVP scoping, Inception Deck).
Develop and present Inception Decks to align stakeholders and development teams.
Explain product context, target users, and market positioning to the engineering team.
Create User Story Maps and define Minimum Viable Products (MVPs).
Plan releases and manage iteration/time-box planning.
Own and manage the Product Backlog (prioritization, refinement, requirement listing).
Translate business requirements into structured epics, user stories, and detailed acceptance criteria, considering: Data flow and dependencies / Edge cases / Non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security)
Work closely with engineers to clarify requirements, review proposed solutions, and ensure technical feasibility without over-engineering.
Ensure backlog items are clearly understood and adjusted promptly when necessary.
Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and validate delivered features against functional and technical acceptance criteria.
Translate requirements into wireframes and user flows where needed.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to ensure usability, visual consistency, and alignment with the Design System.
Act as the key communication bridge between business stakeholders and the development team.
Regularly communicate product progress, risks, and outcomes to business stakeholders.
Align expectations and negotiate scope when necessary.

Experience in banking or financial systems.

KEEP CHALLENGING - Never stay in your comfort zone
CRITICAL THINKING

At OTSV, work is a self-fulfillment, we encourage staff to leave their comfort zone, think out of the box, and share their ideas without hesitation. As a team, we analyze and evaluate issues objectively to learn quickly from mistakes.
We believe in ‘fail quick, success quick’ and strive to keep pace with the forefront of technology to digitize ONE’s business.
The designs of our offices embrace our culture of being flexible and open. Unlike a conventional office, we have an open concept with different work areas which encourages collaboration, open-mindedness, and spontaneity.
Each work area has its charm and aims to make our staff feel as comfortable in the office as they would feel at home. Have a meet-up at the Café amidst the aroma of coffee!
 
You will love working here!
